questions.prompt: The reviewers praised the article for presenting a theoretically __ argument.
questions.explanationTh: ต้องใช้ adjective ขยาย argument: coherent โดย theoretically ขยาย adjective นี้

questions.prompt: The laboratory __ the same protocol for six years before the new standard was introduced.
questions.explanationTh: กิจกรรมดำเนินต่อเนื่องก่อนอีกเหตุการณ์ในอดีต จึงใช้ past perfect continuous

questions.prompt: Participants found the repeated requests for personal information increasingly __.
questions.explanationTh: หลัง found + object ใช้ adjective complement: intrusive

questions.prompt: The policy was implemented so __ that several departments misunderstood its scope.
questions.explanationTh: ขยาย implemented และอยู่ใน so...that จึงใช้ adverb: hastily

questions.prompt: The ethics board advised the researchers against __ minors without parental consent.
questions.explanationTh: against เป็น preposition จึงตามด้วย gerund: recruiting

questions.prompt: The correlation was statistically significant but practically __.
questions.explanationTh: หลัง was และ adverb practically ต้องใช้ adjective: inconsequential

questions.prompt: No final decision __ until all departments have submitted their forecasts.
questions.explanationTh: decision เป็นสิ่งที่ถูกทำในอนาคต จึงใช้ future passive: will be made

questions.prompt: The editor questioned the __ of including data collected under different definitions.
questions.explanationTh: หลัง the ต้องเป็นคำนามที่หมายถึงความเหมาะสม: appropriateness

questions.prompt: The revised instructions are less __ than those issued during the pilot.
questions.explanationTh: หลัง less ใช้ adjective และ ambiguous หมายถึงกำกวม

questions.prompt: If the records had been complete, the auditors __ the discrepancy much sooner.
questions.explanationTh: third conditional ใช้ if + past perfect และ would have + past participle

questions.prompt: The audience appeared genuinely __ by the speaker’s account of the fieldwork.
questions.explanationTh: audience เป็นผู้รับความรู้สึก จึงใช้ fascinated

questions.prompt: Greater transparency would enhance the public __ of the selection process.
questions.explanationTh: หลัง public ต้องเป็นคำนาม: perception

questions.prompt: The agreement permits participating universities __ anonymised data.
questions.explanationTh: permit + object + to-infinitive: permits universities to share

questions.prompt: The authors __ distinguished between evidence and speculation throughout the discussion.
questions.explanationTh: ขยายกริยา distinguished จึงใช้ consistently

questions.prompt: Unless additional funding is secured, the project __ at the end of the semester.
questions.explanationTh: unless + present ใช้ผลในอนาคตด้วย will cease

questions.prompt: The chair’s refusal to disclose the figures was widely regarded as __.
questions.explanationTh: หลัง regarded as ใช้ adjective และบริบทชี้ว่าไม่อาจปกป้องเหตุผลได้: indefensible

questions.prompt: The team postponed __ the results until the anomalous cases had been checked.
questions.explanationTh: postpone ตามด้วย gerund: postponed publishing

questions.prompt: The participants became increasingly __ as the interview moved to sensitive topics.
questions.explanationTh: หลัง became increasingly ใช้ adjective: guarded หมายถึงระมัดระวังไม่เปิดเผย

questions.prompt: The apparent __ between the two accounts disappeared after the dates were corrected.
questions.explanationTh: หลัง the apparent ต้องเป็นคำนาม: contradiction

questions.prompt: The revised consent form is reassuring rather than __ to prospective participants.
questions.explanationTh: form เป็นสิ่งที่ทำให้เกิดความรู้สึก จึงใช้ -ing adjective: intimidating
